property_summary: For any owner/collateral pair (owner != collateral), a clone of C built with immutable args (owner, collateral) must have owner() return the first immutable arg (the owner), which the mutant violates because it reads offset 0x14 and returns the collateral instead.
change_summary: Change the immutable-arg offset in owner() from 0x0 to 0x14 so it returns the collateral address instead of the owner address.
